subject.title: fix(memory): keep shared QMD manager alive on active-memory recall timeout

question: Should this PR's optional `closeActiveMemorySearchManager` scope and `releaseMemoryIndexManagers` runtime hook be accepted as the permanent memory lifecycle contract for active-memory timeout cleanup?
rationale: Code review can verify the mechanics, but plugin SDK and memory runtime lifecycle semantics are compatibility-sensitive and need maintainer intent before merge.

options.title: Accept Scoped Lifecycle Contract
options.body: Merge this shape after rebase and exact-head checks, keeping default full-close behavior while letting active-memory request a narrow index-manager release.

options.title: Keep The Contract Internal
options.body: Ask for a rewrite that fixes memory-core active-memory cleanup without adding a public SDK parameter or runtime hook.

options.title: Defer To Broader Active Memory Redesign
options.body: Pause this PR only if maintainers want the narrow bug fixed as part of a larger active-memory reliability redesign.

recommendation.title: Accept Scoped Lifecycle Contract
recommendation.body: Merge this shape after rebase and exact-head checks, keeping default full-close behavior while letting active-memory request a narrow index-manager release.

likelyOwner.reason: They are recorded as the automerge requester for the merged cleanup work whose lifecycle contract this PR revises.
